selection_reasoning: These three 'find' tasks form a coherent multi-hop exploration sequence. The light_gray_wall_banner is crafted from wool and displayed on a wall, so logically the player must first locate the light_gray_wool (which hints at the banner's material origin), then find the chiseled_red_sandstone (which serves as a distinctive architectural landmark/waypoint), and finally find the light_gray_wall_banner which is mounted on or near the chiseled_red_sandstone structure. This creates a natural navigation chain: wool area → sandstone landmark → banner on the structure. The tasks require visual observation and spatial navigation rather than deep Minecraft crafting knowledge, making them accessible while still forming a meaningful dependency chain where each discovery guides the player toward the next.

edges.reason: The chiseled_red_sandstone structure is located past the wool storage area, requiring the player to navigate through that zone first
The light_gray_wall_banner is mounted on the chiseled_red_sandstone structure, so the player must find the structure to locate the banner

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The player must navigate near the light gray wool blocks (centered at spawn-relative -3, 1, 5 on the oak plank platform to the left of the path) and face toward them. max_distance=8 was chosen (reduced from 16 per ValidatorAgent feedback) because the wool is only ~5.8 blocks from spawn horizontally — a distance of 16 would allow triggering from spawn without meaningful navigation. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the wool stack.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The player must navigate near the chiseled red sandstone structure (centered at spawn-relative 4, 1, 11) and face toward it. max_distance=10 was chosen (reduced from 16 per ValidatorAgent feedback) because the structure is ~11.7 blocks from spawn — a distance of 16 would allow triggering from spawn. At max_distance=10 the player must walk at least 2 blocks along the path. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the structure.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The player must navigate near the light gray wall banner (at spawn-relative 4, 2, 13 on the interior back wall of the sandstone structure, facing north) and face toward it. max_distance=8 requires the player to be within ~8 blocks horizontally of the banner — since the banner is ~13.6 blocks from spawn, the player must walk to at least z≈9 (the archway entrance) and look north toward the back wall. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is facing the banner.

scene_description: A compact exploration scene with three findable targets arranged along a grass path. Light gray wool blocks are stacked on an oak plank platform to the right of the path (~5 blocks from spawn). A chiseled red sandstone structure with an archway entrance sits to the left of the path (~11 blocks from spawn). Inside the structure, a light gray wall banner hangs on the back wall, illuminated by a torch. The grass path guides the player forward from spawn toward both structures.
task_text: Explore the area ahead. First, find the light gray wool blocks on the wooden platform to your right. Then, find the chiseled red sandstone structure further ahead. Finally, enter the structure and find the light gray banner hanging on the back wall inside.
design_notes: Scene layout: Spawn at (0,0,0) on cobblestone. Grass path from (0,0,2) to (0,0,12) guides player forward. Wool platform at (-4 to -2, 0-2, 4-6) is to the LEFT of the path. Sandstone structure at (2-6, 0-3, 9-13) is ahead-right with archway entrance on south face (z=9). Banner at (4,2,13) faces north on interior back wall. Torch at (4,1,11) illuminates interior. Build order: solid fill first, then carve interior with air, then place torch and banner. This eliminates error messages.
